query:
WITH old AS (
                SELECT id, current_stock
                FROM inventory_items
                WHERE id = $1
                    AND household_id = $2
                    AND archived_at IS NULL
                FOR UPDATE
            )
            UPDATE inventory_items AS i
            SET
                current_stock = $3,
                updated_at = $4
            FROM old
                WHERE i.id = old.id
            RETURNING
                old.current_stock AS "stock_before!",
                i.current_stock AS "stock_after!"
